name: ColorField
description:
A colour as a form field: the hex value is typed in place, and the swatch at its start
opens a ColorPicker in a popover. Works inside `Field` like any input.
signature: ({ value: valueProp, defaultValue, onValueChange, onValueCommit, clearable, alpha, swatches, eyeDropper, disabled, locale, labels, size, width, invalid, name, placeholder, id, ref, onBlur, className, ...aria }: ColorFieldProps): import("react").JSX.Element

props.name: alpha
props.description: Offer an opacity slider and keep alpha in the value (`#rrggbbaa`). Default false.

props.name: aria-describedby
props.description: IDs of elements that describe the field (Field sets it).

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Accessible name when no visible label names the field.

props.name: aria-labelledby
props.description: IDs of elements that name the field (Field sets it).

props.name: className
props.description: Classes applied to the outer element for layout. Use the component props and theme tokens for its appearance.

props.name: clearable
props.description: Allow clearing to no colour. Default false.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: The starting colour when uncontrolled; null for none.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables interaction while retaining the component’s disabled appearance.

props.name: eyeDropper
props.description: Offer the browser's eyedropper where it has one (`window.EyeDropper`). Default true.

props.name: id
props.description: A stable element or component identifier.

props.name: invalid
props.description: Show the invalid state (set by Field when its error shows).

props.name: labels
props.type: Partial<{ picker: string; area: string; areaValue: (lightness: number, chroma: number) => string; hue: string; alpha: string; hex: string; eyeDropper: string; swatches: string; open: string; none: string; clear: string; }> | undefined
props.description: Wording overrides for this picker.

props.name: locale
props.description: Formatting and wording locale; defaults to the nearest LocaleProvider.

props.name: name
props.description: Name for a native form submission (a hidden input carries the hex value).

props.name: onBlur
props.description: Called when focus leaves the field, for form libraries' touched state.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Called with the new hex colour, or null when cleared.

props.name: onValueCommit
props.description: Called with the hex colour when a change is finished: the pointer is released, a key is pressed, a swatch is chosen or the hex field commits.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: The prompt shown while the value is empty. It does not replace the field’s label.

props.name: ref
props.description: Receives the underlying element for focus or measurement. React 19 accepts ref as a normal prop.

props.name: size
props.description: Control height: sm, md (default) or lg.

props.name: swatches
props.description: Preset colours shown under the controls.

props.name: value
props.description: The colour as hex, or null for none. Pair with `onValueChange` to control it.

props.name: width
props.description: short or medium; full width by default.
